test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Eliminating.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in **blank number 2 **is **"eliminating."**
 
• The sentence talks about the government and organizations trying to eliminate all practices that discriminate against women.
 
• This means that they are trying to get rid of or remove such practices from society.
 
• The word **"eliminating" **refers to **the act of completely removing or getting rid of something. **
 
 
• ​Example: The company is committed to **eliminating **all forms of discrimination in the workplace.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence:
 
• **"Blacklisting" **means to exclude or boycott someone, usually because they have done something wrong. This word does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Precluding" **means to prevent something from happening or being done. This word does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Exiling" **means to banish or force someone to leave a place. This word does not fit the context of the sentence.
